name: futurama-maker
description: Serviço local de renderização de vídeos para WhatsApp

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @futurama/commands && npm run build --workspace @futurama/templates && npm run build --workspace @futurama/core && npm run build --workspace @futurama/whatsapp && npm run build --workspace @futurama/dashboard
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace @futurama/desktop
